does: Gives a new dummy entity the components of its kind, chosen by a bit set in the second parameter: 0x1FC7 for a character, 8 for a light, 0x1005 for an item or scenery, 0x25 for an effect, 0x15 for a camera, 4 for a sound. The fourth parameter is the timeline type.

evidence.says: Each bit of the second parameter guards the adding of one group of components; the callers pass 0x1FC7 when the source has ecl::Character or the template's type is character, 8 for ls::LightComponent, and so on down to 4 for ls::SoundComponent.
A probe while a dialog starts records 93 calls, one after each CreateDummy, with the bit sets 0x25, 8 and 0x1005 and the timeline type 1 in the fourth argument.
the private ecl::TLPreviewDummyHelpers::SetupDummy(ID const&, EDummyComponents, EntityRef const&, ETimelineType)

Each bit of the second parameter guards the adding of one group of components; the callers pass 0x1FC7 when the source has ecl::Character or the template's type is character, 8 for ls::LightComponent, and so on down to 4 for ls::SoundComponent.

A probe while a dialog starts records 93 calls, one after each CreateDummy, with the bit sets 0x25, 8 and 0x1005 and the timeline type 1 in the fourth argument. Called with 0x1FC7 on a dummy just created, the entity then carries Transform, Level, Sound, AnimationBlueprint, AnimationSet, Physics, Tag, Unsheath, ArmorSetState, TimelineSteering, ClothTeleportData and the client timeline components for look-at, material, shape shift, splatter and animation state.
the private ecl::TLPreviewDummyHelpers::SetupDummy(ID const&, EDummyComponents, EntityRef const&, ETimelineType)
